value.rationale: The cover-time optimal reset rate is a natural search-design invariant. The theorem identifies an exact sharp finite graph-size transition (three vertices vs every larger odd path), proves unique global optimality for the complete size family, and supplies the previously unquantified constant-order lattice correction beyond a known Brownian limit. These provide structural information inaccessible from a single-target first-passage calculation or a sampled simulation.
